The '''Chorios system''',<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> also known as the '''Nam Chorios system''',<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Nam]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]].
